prompts.app: Create ONE original app icon for Sharkside, an age-of-sail shark naval idle game, square 1024x1024. Attached images are ONLY pixel-art material/style references, never copy their objects. Refined 16/32-bit pixel art: rich material colours, discrete shaded clusters, crisp stair-step outlines, restrained deep navy outline, strong upper-left highlights. A powerful blue-gray shark head in three-quarter profile surges diagonally up from a compact turquoise wave, jaws grinning with large ivory triangular teeth, one small golden age-of-sail ship silhouette tucked beside it for scale. Bold simple readable silhouette at 32 pixels; no tiny clutter, no text, no letters, no numbers, no character clothing or humanoid mascot. Gold and coral accents. FULL BLEED solid deep-sea navy #061220 background, opaque square, no rounded corners, no border. All shark/ship focal content inside the central 70-percent-diameter circle for Android maskable cropping. Original independent design.
